chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام that he said:
"If you wish to perform tawaf on behalf of one of your brothers, then go to the Black Stone and say: In the Name of Allah, O Allah, accept from so-and-so."

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah, a direct form of supplication
key_terms.الْحَجَرَ الْأَسْوَدَ: the Black Stone, where the supplication is to be said
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: In the Name of Allah, the opening invocation
key_terms.تَطُوفَ: to perform tawaf, circumambulating the Kaʿbah
key_terms.تَقَبَّلْ: accept, meaning accept the devotional act
key_terms.فُلَانٍ: so-and-so, the person on whose behalf the tawaf is performed

ai.seo_question: What should one say when performing tawaf on behalf of another person?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the formula to be said when performing tawaf on behalf of another believer. It shows both the devotional procedure connected to tawaf and the permissibility of dedicating this act on behalf of someone else.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2829 - It is narrated from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdullah (as), that he said:

"If you wish to perform Tawaf on behalf of one of your brothers, go to the Black Stone and say,
'In the name of Allah (swt), O Allah (swt), accept this on behalf of [the name of the person].'"
